description: Permanently delete one of YOUR OWN discussion comments on a work item, with its attached files. Same rule as the Console: only the key owner's own comment can be deleted (403 not_comment_author, or comment_not_editable for Linear-mirrored and shared-report comments; 404 comment_not_found for an unknown id). A top-level comment that still has replies is refused with 409 comment_has_replies: replies are never removed or re-parented, so delete the replies first. Requires `write` scope and a key owner who is an editor or above.
name: anyforge_delete_work_item_comment
title: Delete work item comment
